## 中文

### 范围

- [ ] 变更范围与 Owner-only Alpha 一致
- [ ] 未提交 PDF、健康数据、聊天、ID、token、OAuth 或运行时秘密

### 证据

- [ ] Python/Swift/iOS/Compose CI 通过
- [ ] 隐私拒绝、备份/恢复与 SHA 回滚已验证
- [ ] 若涉及真实设备或飞书，只记录脱敏计数与结果

### 发布

- [ ] 已记录精确部署 SHA 和回滚 SHA
- [ ] 未经 Owner 明确批准不合并、不创建 Release

## English

### Scope

- [ ] The change matches the owner-only Alpha boundary
- [ ] No PDF, health data, chat, IDs, tokens, OAuth, or runtime secrets are committed

### Evidence

- [ ] Python, Swift, iOS, and Compose CI passes
- [ ] Privacy denial, backup/restore, and SHA rollback are verified
- [ ] Real-device or Feishu evidence contains de-identified counts/results only

### Release

- [ ] Exact deploy and rollback SHAs are recorded
- [ ] No merge or Release occurs without explicit owner approval
